user.title: Connect to the gateway
user.description: Enter the address of the nibe-service-usb gateway and its pairing key.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the machine running nibe-service-usb.
data_description.key: Printed by `nibe-service-usb show-key` on the gateway host: 64 hex characters or dash-grouped base32.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered Nibe gateway
zeroconf_confirm.description: Enter the key for {name} at {host}:{port} to finish setting it up.

data_description.key: Printed by `nibe-service-usb show-key` on the gateway host: 64 hex characters or dash-grouped base32.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The key for the gateway at {host} was rejected. Enter the current key.

data_description.key: Printed by `nibe-service-usb show-key` on the gateway host: 64 hex characters or dash-grouped base32.

reconfigure.title: Change the gateway address
reconfigure.description: Change where Home Assistant connects. The gateway at the new address must have the same server ID. Leave the key empty to keep the stored one.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the machine running nibe-service-usb.
data_description.key: Optional. Leave empty to keep the current key.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the gateway.
error.invalid_key: The key is not valid: use 64 hex characters or dash-grouped base32.
error.unsupported_proto: The gateway speaks an unsupported protocol version.

abort.no_server_id: The discovered gateway did not announce a server ID.
abort.unsupported_proto: The gateway speaks an unsupported protocol version.
abort.server_id_mismatch: The gateway at this address is a different one than the one originally configured.

state.enable: Request heating (push degree minutes toward compressor start)
state.disable: Suppress heating (reset degree minutes every 10 min; safety guards apply)

init.title: Finding the gateway after an address change
init.description: If the gateway stops answering at its stored address, Home Assistant looks for it by its server ID.

data_description.relocate_mdns: Look for the gateway's mDNS announcement (_nibe-usb._tcp) with the stored server ID.
